g.text: Three ways to run the same game server, all described in Bicep and all reached through Bastion
The compute surface you end up with
3.1 main.bicep + modules · what-if before every deployment
Azure Bastion in the hub — still the only administrative door, no workload gets a public IP
3.1 Bicep — modules, .bicepparam per environment, what-if before apply
3.2 VMs — two roles in two availability zones, no public IPs, managed disks
3.3 Containers — one registry, ACI for tasks, Container Apps for services
3.4 App Service — one plan, a staging slot, outbound VNet integration
you control the OS and need long-lived state → Virtual Machine
you have an image and a finite task → Container Instance
you have an image and idle periods → Container App
you have code and want slots without plumbing → App Service
# every one of them is created by the same main.bicep in Lab 3.1
